cobol_source:
******************************************************************  
* PROGRAM NAME                 : CRYPTVE                         *  
* IMPORTANT FILE               : PASSDOC                         *  
* PROGRAMMER                   : KERESTES                        *  
* DATE OF WRITEN               : SEPT. 2022                      *  
* TECHNOLOGY                   : CICS + COBOL + DB2              *  
******************************************************************  
*                   PROBLEM  DEFINITION                          *  
*                                                                *  
* THIS PROGRAM MAKE THE PASSWORD ENCRYPTATION                    *  
******************************************************************  
* INPUT PARAMETERS:                                              *  
*                                                                *  
* PASSWORD, CLIENTID, ADMINDATE                                  *  
******************************************************************  
* OUTPUT PARAMETERS:                                             *  
*                                                                *  
* CONFIRMATION OF THE ENCRYPTED PASSWORD                         *  
******************************************************************  
                                                                    
******************************************************************  
*                  IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.                      *  
******************************************************************  
                                                                    
 IDENTIFICATION                      DIVISION.                      
 PROGRAM-ID. CRYPTVE.                                               
                                                                    
******************************************************************  
*                     ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.                      *  
******************************************************************  
                                                                    
 ENVIRONMENT                               DIVISION.                
                                                                    
*---------------------*                                             
 INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.                                              
*---------------------* 
                                                                  
 FILE-CONTROL. 
                                                                  
     SELECT PASSFILE ASSIGN TO PASSDOC 
     ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL 
     FILE STATUS IS FS-PASSFILE. 
                                                                  
******************************************************************
*                       DATA  DIVISION.                          *
******************************************************************
                                                                  
 DATA                                DIVISION. 
                                                                  
*-------------* 
 FILE SECTION. 
*-------------* 
                                                                  
 FD PASSFILE. 
                                                                  
 01 TOTFILE. 
     02  FILE-USERID    PIC X(8). 
     02  FILE-PASS      PIC X(8). 
     02  FILLER         PIC X(4). 
                                                                  
*------------------------* 
 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 
*------------------------* 
                                                                  
 01  FS-PASSFILE                      PIC X(2). 
     88  FS-PASSFILE-OK               VALUE '00'. 
                                                                  
 01  PASSFILE-KEY                     PIC 9(9) VALUE 0. 
                                                                  
 01  WS-DATE             PIC 9(8). 
                                                                  
 01  WS-USERID1          PIC 9(4) COMP.                             
 01  WS-USERID REDEFINES WS-USERID1 PIC X(2).                       
                                                                    
 01  WS-PASS             PIC 9(4) COMP.                             
 01  WS-PASSWORD REDEFINES WS-PASS PIC X(2).                        
                                                                    
 01  WS-KEY1             PIC 9(4) COMP.                             
 01  WS-KEY REDEFINES WS-KEY1 PIC 9(2).                             
                                                                    
 01  WS-COUNTER1         PIC 9(2).                                  
 01  WS-COUNTER2         PIC 9(2).                                  
                                                                    
 01  WS-MOD1             PIC 9.                                     
                                                                    
 01  WS-CRYPTPASS.                                                  
     02  WS-CRYPTCHAR    PIC X OCCURS 8 TIMES.                      
                                                                    
 01  READ-FLAG           PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.                        
                                                                    
*----------------*                                                  
 LINKAGE SECTION.                                                   
*----------------*                                                  
                                                                    
 01  LS-PASSWORD         PIC X(8).                                  
 01  LS-USERID           PIC X(8).                                  
 01  LS-ADDATE           PIC X(10).                                 
 01  LS-FLAG.                                                       
     02 LS-FLAG-RETURN   PIC X.                                     
     02 LS-FLAG-ERROR    PIC X(4).                                  
*    0 = OK, 1 = INVALID, 2 = ERROR                                 
                                                                    
**************************************************************      
*           PROCEDURE DIVISION WITH LINKAGE SECTION          *      
**************************************************************      
                                                                    
 PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LS-PASSWORD, LS-USERID, LS-ADDATE,        
                                        LS-FLAG.                    
                                                                    
 MAIN-PARA.                                                         
                                                                    
     PERFORM 0100-OPEN-FILE.                                        
     PERFORM 0200-CRYPTPASS.                                        
     PERFORM 0300-COMPARE-PASS.                                     
     PERFORM 0400-CLOSE-FILE.                                       
                                                                    
     GOBACK.                                                        
                                                                    
*****************************************************************   
* 0100-OPEN-FILE.                                               *   
*                                                               *   
* IT OPENS THE FILE TO PUT THE ENCRYPTED PASSWORD.              *   
*****************************************************************   
                                                                    
 0100-OPEN-FILE.                                                    
                                                                    
     OPEN INPUT PASSFILE                                            
                                                                    
     IF NOT FS-PASSFILE-OK                                          
         MOVE 2 TO LS-FLAG-RETURN                                   
         MOVE FS-PASSFILE TO LS-FLAG-ERROR                          
         GO TO 0400-CLOSE-FILE                                      
     END-IF.                                                        
                                                                    
***************************************************************     
* 0200-CRYPTPASS.                                             *     
*                                                             *     
* IT MAKES THE PASSWORD ENCRYPTATION TO COMPARE WITH THE STORE*     
* ENCRYPTED PASSWORD.                                         *     
***************************************************************     
                                                                    
 0200-CRYPTPASS.                                                    
                                                                    
     MOVE LS-USERID(6:3) TO PASSFILE-KEY                            
     ADD 1 TO PASSFILE-KEY                                          
     MOVE LS-ADDATE(1:4) TO WS-DATE(1:4)                            
     MOVE LS-ADDATE(6:2) TO WS-DATE(5:2)                            
     MOVE LS-ADDATE (9:2) TO WS-DATE(7:2)                           
                                                                    
     INITIALIZE WS-CRYPTPASS.                                       
                                                                    
     COMPUTE WS-KEY = FUNCTION RANDOM (WS-DATE) * 1000              
                                                                    
     MOVE LS-USERID(1:4) TO WS-USERID                               
                                                                    
     PERFORM WITH TEST BEFORE VARYING WS-COUNTER1 FROM 1 BY 1       
                        UNTIL WS-COUNTER1 > 8 OR                    
                        LS-PASSWORD(WS-COUNTER1:1) = SPACE          
                                                                    
         PERFORM WITH TEST AFTER VARYING WS-COUNTER2 FROM           
                               WS-COUNTER1 BY 1 UNTIL               
                   WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1) NOT = X'40'  AND       
                   WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1) NOT = X'10'  AND       
                   WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1) NOT = X'00'  AND       
                   WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1) NOT = X'30'  AND       
                   WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1) NOT = X'20'            
                                                                    
         COMPUTE WS-MOD1 = FUNCTION MOD(WS-COUNTER2 3)              
                                                                    
         MOVE LS-PASSWORD(WS-COUNTER1:2) TO WS-PASSWORD             
         MOVE LS-USERID(WS-COUNTER1:2) TO WS-USERID                 
                                                                    
         EVALUATE WS-MOD1                                           
            WHEN 0                                                  
                COMPUTE WS-KEY1 = WS-PASS * WS-KEY1                 
                                                                    
                MOVE WS-KEY1 TO WS-PASS                             
                MOVE WS-PASSWORD(2:1) TO WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1)  
                                                                    
            WHEN 1                                                    
                COMPUTE WS-USERID1 = WS-PASS * WS-USERID1             
                                                                      
                MOVE WS-USERID(2:1) TO WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1)      
                                                                      
            WHEN 2                                                    
             COMPUTE  WS-KEY1 = WS-PASS * WS-USERID1 * WS-KEY1        
                                                                      
                MOVE WS-KEY1 TO WS-PASS                               
                MOVE WS-PASSWORD(2:1) TO WS-CRYPTCHAR(WS-COUNTER1)    
                                                                      
         END-EVALUATE                                                 
                                                                      
         END-PERFORM                                                  
                                                                      
     END-PERFORM.                                                     
                                                                      
*****************************************************************     
* 0300-COMPARE-PASS                                             *     
*                                                               *     
* IT MAKES THE COMPARATION BETWEEN THE STORED PASSWORD AND THE  *     
* PASSWORD ENCRYPTED BY THIS PROGRAM.                           *     
*****************************************************************     
                                                                      
 0300-COMPARE-PASS.                                                   
                                                                      
     DISPLAY WS-CRYPTPASS                                             
     DISPLAY LS-USERID                                                
                                                                      
     MOVE 9 TO LS-FLAG-RETURN                                         
                                                                      
     READ PASSFILE                                                    
         AT END MOVE 'Y' TO READ-FLAG                                 
     END-READ                                                         
                                                                      
     IF NOT FS-PASSFILE-OK                                            
        MOVE 2 TO LS-FLAG-RETURN                                    
        MOVE FS-PASSFILE TO LS-FLAG-ERROR                           
        GO TO 0400-CLOSE-FILE                                       
     END-IF                                                         
                                                                    
     PERFORM UNTIL READ-FLAG = 'Y' OR NOT FS-PASSFILE-OK            
        IF LS-USERID = FILE-USERID                                  
           MOVE 'Y' TO READ-FLAG                                    
           MOVE 0 TO LS-FLAG-RETURN                                 
        ELSE                                                        
           READ PASSFILE                                            
               AT END MOVE 'Y' TO READ-FLAG                         
           END-READ                                                 
        END-IF                                                      
     END-PERFORM                                                    
                                                                    
     IF LS-FLAG-RETURN = 0                                          
        IF WS-CRYPTPASS NOT = FILE-PASS                             
           MOVE 1 TO LS-FLAG-RETURN                                 
        END-IF                                                      
     ELSE                                                           
        IF FS-PASSFILE-OK                                           
           MOVE 1 TO LS-FLAG-RETURN                                 
        ELSE                                                        
           MOVE 2 TO LS-FLAG-RETURN                                 
           MOVE FS-PASSFILE TO LS-FLAG-ERROR                        
           GO TO 0400-CLOSE-FILE                                    
        END-IF                                                      
     END-IF.                                                        
                                                                    
***************************************************************     
* 0400-CLOSE-FILE                                             *     
*                                                             *     
* IT CLOSES THE PS FILE                                       *     
***************************************************************     
                                                                    
  0400-CLOSE-FILE. 
                                                                  
     CLOSE PASSFILE 
                                                                  
     IF NOT FS-PASSFILE-OK 
        MOVE 2 TO LS-FLAG-RETURN 
        MOVE FS-PASSFILE TO LS-FLAG-ERROR 
     END-IF.

plan.approach: The COBOL program CRYPTVE is a called sub-program (CICS LINK target) that accepts three LINKAGE-SECTION parameters (password, userId, adminDate), encrypts the password using a proprietary byte-manipulation algorithm seeded by the adminDate and userId, then validates the result against a record read from a sequential flat-file (PASSDOC). The migration wraps the entire flow in a single POST REST endpoint. The sequential file is replaced by a PostgreSQL table ('passdoc') accessed via Spring Data JPA. The four COBOL paragraphs (OPEN-FILE, CRYPTPASS, COMPARE-PASS, CLOSE-FILE) are mapped to clearly named Java methods. File open/close lifecycle is delegated to the JPA connection pool. The LS-FLAG output structure (flagReturn + flagError) is modelled as a Java record and returned as the HTTP response body, with HTTP status codes (200/401/500) reflecting the COBOL return codes (0/1/2).
patterns_used: Repository pattern (Spring Data JPA replacing sequential file I/O)
Factory method on response DTO (ok(), invalid(), error())
Switch Expression (Java 17, mod-3 branch selection and HTTP status mapping)
plan.sql_strategy: The COBOL program reads a sequential flat-file (PASSDOC) record-by-record searching for a matching FILE-USERID. This O(n) sequential scan is replaced by a single primary-key lookup via PassDocumentRepository.findByUserId(paddedUserId), which generates a WHERE userid = ? query through Spring Data JPA. The PASSDOC file layout (FILE-USERID PIC X(8), FILE-PASS PIC X(8), FILLER PIC X(4)) is modelled as the 'passdoc' PostgreSQL table with columns userid (CHAR/VARCHAR 8) and pass (CHAR/VARCHAR 8). spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=validate is used so the schema is pre-created via a migration tool (Flyway/Liquibase) rather than auto-generated.
plan.call_strategy: CRYPTVE is itself a called sub-program (PROCEDURE DIVISION USING ...). In the Spring Boot world it becomes a @Service bean. Any CICS LINK/XCTL that previously called CRYPTVE is replaced by an HTTP POST to /api/v1/crypto/verify. The internal paragraph PERFORM calls (0100 through 0400) are replaced by private service method invocations within CryptoService.verify(). The encryption inner loop (PERFORM WITH TEST AFTER) is reproduced as a Java do-while loop with identical exit conditions. COBOL REDEFINES of COMP fields over PIC X overlays are reproduced using Java byte-array manipulations with ISO-8859-1 encoding to preserve binary content faithfully.
